codes.meaning: The complete ACL-06 generated root passed integrity checks.
All registered reference gates passed; reporting only, not promotion.
Held-out behavior did not exceed the best baseline by the required margin.
Baseline remains a comparator only.
Baseline artifacts are reference comparators, not promotable candidates.
Diagnostic candidate is excluded from multiple-testing family.
Diagnostic evidence is visible but cannot enter selection or promotion.
Directional effect or signed result is below policy.
Side-aware cost and fill evidence is absent.
Family-corrected q-value did not clear policy.
No independent replication is bound.
Total or held-out support is below the frozen threshold.
At least one required gate is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
Out-of-distribution and selective-control evidence is absent.
Overfit controls did not clear.
No frozen prospective run is bound.
Candidate belongs to the research lane.
Train, validation and test behavior is missing or unstable.
Nominal p-value or Wilson lower bound did not clear policy.
Tail sample is too small or adverse.
Known-time and purged-split evidence is bound from ACL-06.
